## Summary

Ishwar Sahani (also known as Ishwar Kumar) is a Frontend Developer based in Gurugram, India. He works full-time at a startup where he builds product UI for platforms like Klakar (an artist network) and Dizivizi (a video-location platform) using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Alongside his full-time role, he takes on selective freelance frontend projects for clients across India.

He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering and has spent the last year owning frontend features end-to-end in a fast-moving startup environment — translating product requirements into responsive, accessible, and production-ready interfaces.

### Klakar — Frontend Developer

- **Company:** Klakar
- **Company URL:** https://klakar.com/
- **Role:** Frontend Developer
- **Period:** 2025 — Present
- **Location:** Gurugram, India
- **Current:** Yes
- **Project:** Klakar — Network for Artists
- **Project URL:** https://klakar.com/

Klakar is a startup platform where creative professionals build standout portfolios, find work and collaborators, learn from working pros, and let AI handle the busywork. Working as a full-time Frontend Developer in a fast-moving startup environment, owning UI implementation end-to-end across product surfaces.

**Highlights:**

- Own and ship frontend features for Klakar's artist network product using Next.js, React, and TypeScript in a startup environment.
- Translate product requirements and Figma designs into responsive, accessible, and production-ready UI components with Tailwind CSS.
- Collaborate directly with founders and backend engineers to integrate APIs, shape product flows, and unblock delivery on tight startup timelines.
- Improve performance and Core Web Vitals through image optimization, code splitting, and modern Next.js App Router patterns.

**Focus Areas:** Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Startup Frontend

### Dizivizi — Frontend Developer

- **Company:** Dizivizi
- **Company URL:** https://dizivizi.com/
- **Role:** Frontend Developer
- **Period:** 2024 — 2025
- **Location:** Remote, India
- **Project:** Dizivizi — Video-location Platform
- **Project URL:** https://dizivizi.com/

Dizivizi is a video-sharing platform where users tag videos to map locations so others can discover content by place. Worked on the frontend, building and maintaining responsive UI, interactive map experiences, and dynamic video player interfaces for web.

**Highlights:**

- Implemented interactive map-based video discovery UI using React and JavaScript, letting users browse videos pinned to real-world locations.
- Built responsive video player and listing components for the Dizivizi web platform across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
- Integrated backend APIs for video upload, geotagging, and feed rendering with clean loading and error states.
- Collaborated with the product team to refine UX flows for video tagging, search, and location-based discovery.

**Focus Areas:** React.js, JavaScript, Interactive Maps, Video Player UI, Responsive Design

## Services

### Frontend Website Development

Modern, responsive, and SEO-friendly websites built with Next.js, React, HTML5, CSS3, and Tailwind CSS. Delivered for startups, small businesses, and personal brands across Gurugram and India.

### Next.js Full Stack Development

Production web applications built end-to-end with Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Node.js APIs, and database integration. Full-stack delivery from UI to deploy on Vercel.

### MERN Stack Development

Full-stack web apps using the MERN stack — MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Includes REST API design, JWT authentication, and MongoDB schema modeling for production use.

### PERN Stack Development

Relational full-stack applications using the PERN stack — PostgreSQL, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Includes schema design, REST APIs, and type-safe data flows.

### React.js Development

Component-driven web applications and dashboards built with React.js, TypeScript, and modern hooks. Focused on reusable UI, performance, and maintainable code.

### Node.js Backend & API Integration

REST API design and frontend integration using Node.js, Express, and modern fetch patterns. Covers authentication, error handling, and clean client-side data fetching.

### Tailwind CSS and Responsive UI

Mobile-first layouts and design-system-driven UIs with Tailwind CSS v4. Polished responsive interfaces that improve usability, speed, and conversion.
